---
title: "easydta: plots (coupled forest + SROC)"
output: html_document
---

Demonstrates that `dta_forest()` returns sens and spec **side by side as a
single composite output** (labels + sens + spec panels aligned via
`gridExtra::grid.arrange(ncol = 3)`), and that `dta_sroc()` produces a full
SROC with confidence region, prediction region, and AUC.

```{r packages}
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(easydta, ggplot2, grid, gridExtra)
```

```{r load_data}
path <- system.file("extdata/anti_ccp.csv", package = "easydta")
d <- utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r fit}
long <- dta_reshape(d, tp = "TP", fp = "FP", fn = "FN", tn = "TN",
                    studlab = "studlab", extra = "generation")
fit <- dta_fit_single(long)
```

```{r save_forest}
png("forest_coupled.png", width = 1400, height = 1100, res = 150)
dta_forest(fit, d, studlab = "studlab")   # single output, sens + spec side by side
dev.off()
```

```{r save_sroc}
png("sroc_with_auc.png", width = 1200, height = 1100, res = 150)
p <- dta_sroc(fit, auc_method = "trapz")
print(p)
dev.off()
cat("AUC =", attr(p, "AUC"), "\n")
```
